title: Ohm Boy Cranberry Apple & Raspberry 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Cranberry Apple & Raspberry from Ohm Boy is a vibrant and tangy medley that will awaken your taste buds. The tartness of Cranberries complements the natural sweetness of Apples, while the ripe Raspberries add a burst of fruity goodness. Together, these ingredients create a harmonious symphony of flavours, leaving you with a refreshing and invigorating vaping experience. Shortfill bottles from Ohm Boy E-liquids provide the ideal way to personalize your nicotine levels to your exact preference. Each bottle comes with 100ml of nicotine-free e-liquid and an additional 20ml of space for two nicotine shots, giving you complete control over your vaping experience. To create 120ml of 3mg e-liquid, simply add 2 x 10ml 18mg nicotine shots to a 100ml shortfill, give it a good shake, and voila, you have your perfect mix. Shortfills not only offer extended longevity from your favourite e-liquid flavours but also serve as an economical and convenient option. Thanks to their higher VG content, they're the perfect match for high-powered, sub-ohm vape kits and low-resistance coils, ensuring maximum flavour and vapour production. Make your vaping more efficient and enjoyable by stocking up on your preferred e-liquids in Shortfills. Ohm Boy has emerged as one of the most innovative e-liquid manufacturers in the UK, thanks to flavours that refine and push the boundaries of e-juices into delicious new territory. Their range covers a wide spectrum of fruit and beverage blends, always with a unique take on flavours with captivating and complex characteristics.
